implementation_commit: the local commit containing this artifact

trigger.disposition: The result disproved AUD-02's earlier cross-App regression claim, so AUD-02 was reopened instead of weakening the current-data registry.

equity_read_path.problem: DjangoStockRepository construction eagerly built all On-Demand synchronization use cases. The audited price and quote factories loaded the system-audit runtime before any read-through hydration was requested.
equity_read_path.failure: Pure Equity reads failed with SystemAuditCompositionUnavailable before their publication/freshness assertions ran.

account_test_profile.problem: tests.support.runtime_config.configure_account_runtime activated a Data Center patch without explicitly seeding the three new critical Audit definitions introduced by AUD-01.
account_test_profile.failure: Account exchange-rate tests failed during fixture setup with Missing critical runtime definitions; the exchange-rate production path itself did not compose an audit writer.

verification_mode.problem: One Risk Center registered node depends on scenario seed migrations 0004/0006. --no-migrations removes that fixture and is therefore not a valid final full-registry acceptance mode.
verification_mode.probe: The isolated node failed with --no-migrations and passed 1/1 with real migrations.
verification_mode.final_rule: The closing full-registry command uses --reuse-db but does not disable migrations.

on_demand_boundary: OnDemandDataCenterService now accepts typed synchronization factories.
The composition root passes factory callables without resolving them.
Read-only assess methods never compose write dependencies.
Hydration resolves a factory only inside the existing guarded provider loop; unavailable composition yields provider_failed diagnostics and zero records, never a successful write.
runtime_test_boundary: The account test helper explicitly seeds an Audit mode=off, outbox=false and a complete typed authority selector before activating account/provider settings.
No production default, fallback, global test fixture or fabricated production authority was added.
goal_stop_contract: The active-plan validator now permits execution_focus.unit_id=null only when there are zero active and zero dependency-ready repository units.
Null focus remains fail-closed when any repository unit is active, planned and dependency-ready, or waiting with all dependencies complete.

validation.command: pytest <Equity repository/intraday/API + Account API/freshness boundary files> -q --reuse-db --no-migrations

validation.skip_boundary: Dedicated PostgreSQL opt-in paths remain unavailable in the local SQLite environment.

validation.command: python scripts/check_audit_event_contracts.py && python scripts/check_current_data_contracts.py && python scripts/check_celery_task_contracts.py
Black, isort, Ruff and git diff --check over changed files

luna_read_only_audit.conclusion: The Data Center On-Demand factory boundary is the narrowest cross-App fix; Account exchange-rate failures belong to explicit test runtime composition, not production fallback.

limitations: Eight PostgreSQL-specific component tests remain opt-in skipped because no dedicated local PostgreSQL test database was configured. They remain AUD-03 production-validation evidence and are not reported as passed.
No production migration, deployment, runtime activation, outbox dispatch, fault injection, archive/restore or owner/reviewer sign-off was performed.
The final full-registry result uses real migrations. A --no-migrations probe produced one expected missing-seed failure and is retained only as diagnostic evidence.

rollback.code: Restore eager On-Demand use-case injection only together with a replacement read/write composition boundary; never add an audit runtime fallback.
rollback.test_profile: Remove the explicit Account test seed only if another owner-bound test fixture supplies all critical definitions.
rollback.governance: Restore a non-null focus only when a repository unit is genuinely dependency-ready and active.
